title: Megapowers Review Receipt v2
description: v2 adds subject.base, required for a worktree-diff subject, and the optional supplemental subject.submodules. subject.id fingerprints the pending delta only, so a delta on its own names a shape that unrelated repositories share. Base plus delta determines the complete tracked content, which is what a receipt has to bind. A gitlink is outside that: it diffs as a bare commit pointer and its untracked content does not diff at all, so subject.submodules binds the content behind it. The Stop hook honors v2 receipts only: a v1 receipt records no base and cannot say which tree state its reviewer read. The optional `independence` field names WHICH separation the review achieved; absent means cross-vendor, which is what every receipt written before the field existed recorded, so older receipts keep validating unchanged.

allOf.description: independent:true is the cross-vendor claim and nothing else may assert it. A context-separation receipt records a fresh same-vendor session, which is the proven half of independent review but not the vendor-independent one, so it must not be able to spell itself as the stronger claim.

base.description: Object name of HEAD when the delta was captured, or the empty tree in a repository with no commits. Read with replacement objects disabled, so a refs/replace entry cannot make one ref OID stand for another tree.

submodules.description: Supplemental fingerprint of the submodule snapshot shown in the review package: pointer moves, worktree content and the submodule's own untracked files, recursively. Present only when the tree holds a gitlink. Deliberately outside subject.id, which must keep the value the shipped algorithm produces; absent and empty are the same thing to a consumer.

independence.description: Which separation the reviewer actually had. cross-vendor: the reviewer's vendor authored none of the artifact. context-separation: no cross-vendor route was reachable and the review ran as a fresh same-vendor session, the condition arXiv 2603.12123 measured at 28.6% F1 against 24.6% for same-session self-review. Absent is cross-vendor, for receipts written before this field.
